summary: The diff implements Hindi translations across all major components and pages of the application. All 13 requirements (REQ-28 through REQ-40) appear to have corresponding changes in the diff. The Navigation, Hero, Mission, SupportOptions, Footer, Home, About, Programs, Philosophy, Resources, Contact, Donate, and Admin files all show Hindi text. The scroll indicator in Hero lacks explicit text but uses only an icon (ArrowDown), which may be acceptable. Some files are truncated so full verification is limited, but overall coverage appears comprehensive.

missing_requirements.requirement: Scroll indicator text in Hero component should be in Hindi
missing_requirements.reason: The Hero component scroll indicator only renders an ArrowDown icon with no visible text label. If the original had English scroll indicator text, it was not translated but removed. The diff shows only an icon element with no accompanying Hindi text.
